notes.title: Giveaway on September 10
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
I have an important announcement to make — [i]Press Any Button[/i] will be free for one day on September 10, 2024. This date is World Suicide Prevention Day, and since my game touches on this subject, I thought it would be fitting to make it available to as many people as possible on that day. Take care of yourselves and your loved ones.

A few technical details: the giveaway will start at 10 AM PT on September 10 and will be live for 24 hours. If you download the game during those 24 hours, it will be yours to keep forever. I’d be really grateful if you could share this news on your social media. If you enjoy the game and want to support me, you can buy the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1509410/Press_Any_Button__Mini_Art_Book/]mini art book[/url] and the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2141110/Press_Any_Button_Soundtrack/]soundtrack[/url]. You can also try the demo of my [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1711790/Knight_of_the_Lions/]upcoming game[/url] and add it to your wishlist. The demo is still a bit rough around the edges, but the final game will be much more polished. I'm hoping to release it by the end of this year or early next year.
Wishing you all a great day!

notes.title: Discounts and War in Ukraine
notes.content:
I'd like to announce that [i]Press Any Button[/i] and [i]Many Buttons to Press[/i] will be discounted for the whole next week! Don't miss this opportunity to buy them and save your money!

And there is one more thing. I live in Ukraine and you might have heard about the war that had started in this country. I have a personal request for you:

I don't ask you to waste your money on something you are not going to play, but if you already have my games wishlisted and are thinking about buying them one day, please, do it now. If you want to spend more, purchase them right away, if you want to spend less – wait for the next week's discounts. Thank you either way. I'm not a military person. The money I'll get from selling my games will buy food for me and my family and pay my rent and utilities. I'm not going to buy any weapons of war to kill anyone. There's already enough pain and death around.

notes.title: Sequel to Press Any Button?
notes.content:
I never intended to continue the story of A-Eye. Let me rephrase that – I never thought about that possibility. But then, a few months ago, I needed to add the Spanish language to the game. As I was copying and pasting translated lines, I couldn't help thinking about how lovable this little fellow is. And I wanted him to tell another story. But he's on his own now, so I couldn't force him to do that. Luckily, he finally has something to say. It seems that he found his way to Twitter. Follow him there if you want to know what he's up to:

[url=https://twitter.com/A_Eyeing]https://twitter.com/A_Eyeing[/url]

notes.title: Steam Awards Nomination
notes.content:
I wasn't sure that Press Any Button is the type of game that obtains awards. But it looks like for one reason or another, some players are going to nominate it anyway. After all, the Steam Awards are players' choice. If you want to support the game, who am I to decide whether it is good enough or not? But with this announcement, I can coordinate your support.

Since you can nominate Press Any Button for one category only, I suggest that it should be [b]"Story-Rich Game"[/b]. But of course, it is still your choice. Thank you for your support!

Oh, and wait till December 7. I'm going to make an important announcement that day!

notes.title: The Spanish language is now available
notes.content:
All credit for that translation goes to [b]Matías Herrero[/b]. He is the one who taught A-Eye how to speak Spanish for which I'm truly grateful.

Also I don't want to make any promises, I'm just curious: Would you like [i]Press Any Button[/i] to be translated to other languages?

Since there are no options or settings in the game, you will have to uninstall it and install it again to play in Spanish. Before installation, Steam will suggest that you select your language (and if your Steam interface is in Spanish, the game will probably be installed in that language by default).

All the best,
Eugene Zubko

notes.title: Important update on switching from free to paid
notes.content:
Okay, it's embarrassing. I should have made more research before posting my previous announcement. In it, I wrote the following: 'If you already have the game in your library, this change will not affect you in any way'. Sadly, the truth is that it's not the case. Today I received a message from Steam Support providing the following information:

[i]Please note that free players won't keep the game. If they still have it installed, it should still be playable, but after uninstalling, the game will be removed from their libraries.[/i]

I was sure, for some reason, that after switching a game from free to paid all free users will keep it forever. But they will not. I want to imply that it was my mistake. Steam Support are very nice people and they have nothing to do with this misunderstanding.

Sorry for being such a dummy. I really should have obtained more information before making any announcement. My bad.

Now, if you want to play the game, you have 3 options:

[olist]
[*] Do it before the end of the week. It will only take you about an hour.
[*] Install it before the end of the week and play it later. The game will be removed from your library only after uninstalling.
[*] Buy it after it becomes paid. I will be grateful if you do. The game is not going to be expensive.
[/olist]

I can't help but feel that I'm making an excessive amount of unnecessary fuss around my game. I don't mean to. After all, it's a little thing, not a masterpiece or something. But for me as its author, it is very flattering to see that after reading the announcement about switching the game from free to paid, thousands of new players downloaded and played it. 

Thank you for your time and your feedback!

Hopefully, this measure will help me to fund the development of my new game which is still going on but not as fast as I expected.

All the best,
Eugene Zubko.

notes.title: It's been 2 months since the release!
notes.content:
A little more in fact, but I missed the opportunity to make this post on March 7.

I wish to thank all of you good people for playing 'Press Any Button'. I hoped I would be lucky enough to get at least a few hundred people interested. But the game turned out to be more popular. It was played by more than 12,000 players and, more important, many enjoyed it. Thank you for your feedback, both positive and negative. I read all of your reviews.

And since you seemingly liked what I did, I decided to make another game. The concept and the script are almost ready. But there's nothing to show you yet. Stay tuned!

I also want to say a special thank you to those of you who bought the Art Book. I really appreciate your generosity. I decided to reduce the price to $2.99 for one month (permanently, if this experiment is a success). If you wanted to donate me some money but felt like 10 bucks was too much, now is your chance.

Hope to be back soon with more details about my future project!

All the best,
Eugene Zubko
